description: Model-authoring templates. Each builds a ModelSpec extending the FeynRules SM.fr model from supplied values. Masses, widths and couplings have no defaults; names, PDG codes and LHA block names are conventions with editable defaults.

templates.title: Colour-triplet scalar leptoquark coupled to one quark type and one lepton type
templates.lagrangian_latex: \mathcal{L} \supset (D_\mu S)^\dagger D^\mu S - M_S^2 S^\dagger S + \lambda^L_{ij}\, \bar q_i P_L \ell_j\, S + \lambda^R_{ij}\, \bar q_i P_R \ell_j\, S + \mathrm{h.c.} \quad (F=0);\; \bar q \to \overline{q^c},\ S \to S^\dagger \quad (F=2)
conventions: Fields are in the mass basis: q is uq (up-type) or dq (down-type), l is l (charged lepton) or vl (neutrino).
Fermion number 0: the leptoquark charge is Q(q) - Q(l). Fermion number 2: the coupling uses the charge-conjugate quark and the conjugate leptoquark, and the charge is Q(q) + Q(l).
Coupling matrices are indexed [quark generation][lepton generation]; P_L = (1 - gamma5)/2.
The leptoquark is declared as a colour triplet; an anti-triplet leptoquark is the conjugate of this field.

name.description: field class name (at least two characters)

width_GeV.description: total width in GeV written to the model (use the decay computation in MadGraph to replace it)

fermion_number.description: fermion number F of the leptoquark

charge.description: electric charge of the leptoquark as an exact fraction; checked against the coupling

coupling_R.description: 3x3 coupling to right-handed leptons (zero for neutrinos)

block.description: LHA block prefix for the couplings

templates.title: Colour-triplet vector leptoquark coupled to one quark type and one lepton type
templates.lagrangian_latex:
\mathcal{L} \supset -	frac12 U^\dagger_{\mu
u} U^{\mu
u} + M_U^2 U^\dagger_\mu U^\mu - i g_s (1-\kappa_U) U^\dagger_\mu T^a U_
u G^{a\mu
u} + g^L_{ij}\,  ar q_i \gamma^\mu P_L \ell_j\, U_\mu + g^R_{ij}\,  ar q_i \gamma^\mu P_R \ell_j\, U_\mu + \mathrm{h.c.}
conventions: U_{mu nu} = D_mu U_nu - D_nu U_mu with the SM covariant derivative; kappa_U = 1 is the Yang-Mills (gauge) case, kappa_U = 0 the minimal-coupling case.
Fermion number 0 gives charge Q(q) - Q(l); fermion number 2 uses the charge-conjugate quark and charge Q(q) + Q(l).
Coupling matrices are indexed [quark generation][lepton generation].

charge.description: electric charge as an exact fraction

coupling_R.description: 3x3 coupling to right-handed leptons (zero for neutrinos)

kappa.description: non-minimal gluon coupling kappa_U (1 for the Yang-Mills case)

templates.title: Neutral massive vector with vector and axial couplings to quarks and leptons, optional kinetic mixing
templates.lagrangian_latex:
\mathcal{L} \supset -	frac14 Z'_{\mu
u} Z'^{\mu
u} + 	frac12 M_{Z'}^2 Z'_\mu Z'^\mu + Z'_\mu \sum_{f=u,d,\ell}  ar f \gamma^\mu (g_V^f - g_A^f \gamma^5) f + g_L^
u\, Z'_\mu  ar
u \gamma^\mu P_L 
u - 	frac{\epsilon}{2} Z'_{\mu
u} B^{\mu
u}
conventions: Couplings are flavour universal within each fermion type; g_V and g_A multiply gamma^mu and gamma^mu gamma^5 with the sign shown.

Kinetic mixing (optional) is applied to first order in epsilon after the canonical field redefinition: the new vector couples to -epsilon g1 times the SM fermion hypercharge current. Z-Zprime mass mixing is not included.
With a nonzero coupling the field interferes with the SM photon and Z exchange in Drell-Yan; use the interference stage template to separate the parts.

kinetic_mixing.description: kinetic-mixing parameter epsilon with hypercharge (0 for none)

u} 	ilde G^{a\mu

conventions: Dual field strengths are tilde X^{mu nu} = (1/2) epsilon^{mu nu rho sigma} X_{rho sigma}; couplings are in GeV^-1.
The photon coupling is g_{a gamma gamma} = g_aBB cos^2(theta_W) + g_aWW sin^2(theta_W) in this convention.
Fermion couplings of the axion-like particle are not part of this template.

stage_templates.title: Leading-order signal, interference and SM parts of one final state
stage_templates.description: Generate the SM part (new-coupling order 0 in |M|^2), the interference part (order k) and the pure new-physics part (order 2k) of one process with the same parameter point, PDF and scales; the full process equals their sum. The interference sample has signed weights. Produced by 'ravel model interference'.
